description: Student's two-sample t-test with pooled variance of whether two independent samples have the same mean. sample_index (0 or 1) assigns each row to a sample. Returns the t statistic, degrees of freedom and the two-sided p-value.

examples.code: SELECT student_t_test(value, CASE WHEN treated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM t;

name: welch_t_test
returnType: STRUCT(t_statistic DOUBLE, degrees_of_freedom DOUBLE, p_value DOUBLE)
description: Welch's unequal-variance t-test of whether two independent samples have the same mean. sample_index (0 or 1) assigns each row to a sample. Returns the t statistic, Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom and the two-sided p-value.

examples.code: SELECT welch_t_test(value, CASE WHEN treated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM t;

name: dist_binomial_fit
returnType: STRUCT(prob DOUBLE, log_likelihood DOUBLE, aic DOUBLE, bic DOUBLE)
description: Fits a binomial distribution to x by maximum likelihood. Returns a STRUCT with the fitted parameters (prob) followed by the log_likelihood, aic and bic of the fit, or NULL when there are too few or only identical values. trials is the known number of trials and must be the same for every row of a group.

name: dist_cauchy_fit
returnType: STRUCT("location" DOUBLE, scale DOUBLE, log_likelihood DOUBLE, aic DOUBLE, bic DOUBLE)
description: Fits a Cauchy distribution to x by maximum likelihood (Newton's method). Returns a STRUCT with the fitted parameters (location, scale) followed by the log_likelihood, aic and bic of the fit, or NULL when there are too few or only identical values. The whole sample is held in memory.

The whole sample is held in memory.

name: dist_negative_binomial_fit
returnType: STRUCT(successes DOUBLE, prob DOUBLE, log_likelihood DOUBLE, aic DOUBLE, bic DOUBLE)
description: Fits a negative binomial distribution to x by maximum likelihood. Returns a STRUCT with the fitted parameters (successes, prob) followed by the log_likelihood, aic and bic of the fit, or NULL when there are too few or only identical values. successes is restricted to whole numbers, as the distribution functions require; cast it to BIGINT to use it. Returns NULL when the variance does not exceed the mean. The whole sample is held in memory.

name: dist_students_t_fit
returnType: STRUCT(degrees_of_freedom DOUBLE, log_likelihood DOUBLE, aic DOUBLE, bic DOUBLE)
description: Fits a standard Student's t distribution to x by maximum likelihood (golden section search). Returns a STRUCT with the fitted parameters (degrees_of_freedom) followed by the log_likelihood, aic and bic of the fit, or NULL when there are too few or only identical values. Returns NULL when the tails are no heavier than normal, where the degrees of freedom are unbounded. The whole sample is held in memory.
